title: Morning traffic log — priorities & quick prep
content:
7:00am quick scan — brain dump / not polished (keep short)

Top 3 (traffic light):
- RED — Dedicated capacity contract: finalize SOW language w/ legal today. Need decision on 99.9% latency SLA vs 99.95% tradeoffs. Call with Legal @ 10:30. Prep: redline summary, key risks, pricing table, renewal term options.
- AMBER — Private deployment pilot onboarding (FinReg client): confirm infra checklist + PoC timeline. Action: confirm network team assigned and key contact (CC: Marco).
- GREEN — Hosted API feature toggle rollout: canary window midday, rollback condition metrics set, inform support rotations.

Meetings to prep (notes & ask):
- 09:00 Product sync (30m) — ask runtime team for kernel selection summary for 8k model; request brief on expected perf delta if quantized to 4-bit. Bring up canary rollout plan and one-pager.
- 10:30 Legal (45m) — SOW redlines. Goal: get alignment on risk matrix and whether we accept tiered SLA. Ask for expedited sign-off timeline.
- 13:00 Customer check-in (FinReg pilot) — reassure on data isolation + encryption; ask them to prioritize test credentials by EOD. Prep: one-slide network diagram + checklist.
- 16:00 Exec standup (15m) — two bullets: decision on SLA by COB & pilot infra owner assigned.

Follow-ups / quick wins:
- Ping EngInfra channel: need network engineer alias for FinReg by 11:00.
- Follow up with Solutions Eng: finalize runbook for canary rollback (attach to PR #287).
- Remind Ops to extend logs retention for pilot cluster to 90d (audit ask).

Notes to self / decisions to make:
- SLA: prefer 99.95% if we can keep cost delta < 12% — ask finance for modeled impact.
- Pricing: consider 10% introductory discount for pilot with 6mo commit; keep auto-escalation on usage.
- Rollouts: require automatic fallback to smaller model family in case of capacity spike — ensure routing policy added.

Quick schedule blocks (today):
- 08:00–09:00: deep work (SOW redlines)
- 11:00–12:00: follow-up + send action items
- 12:00–12:30: lunch (no meetings)
- 15:00–15:30: review canary metrics with Console team

People / trust checks:
- Marco: own pilot infra assignment + confirm engineer by 11:00
- Aisha: own customer comms for FinReg check-in; draft email after meeting
- Legal (T. Huang): escalate SLA language if blockers

Risk flags (quick):
- Audit requirement: encryption-at-rest proof must be included in SOW (legal + security signoff)
- Capacity: Dedicated pool schedule conflicts next week — possible 48h provisioning lag if not prioritized

One-liners for updates (use in standup) — pick 2: 
- "SLA tradeoffs under legal review; will decide by COB if finance can hold cost delta to target."
- "FinReg pilot largely green pending infra assignment and credentials; prepping runbook and network checklist."
- "Hosted API canary scheduled today; rollback rules ready and support rota notified."

Loose TODO (later this week):
- Draft short customer-facing FAQ for pilot (security + SLA Qs)
- Prep onboarding checklist for Private package (KMS/HSM steps)
- Review Optimize recommendations for top 3 customers — possible savings talk

Random reminders / quick notes:
- Slack: #eng-serving-runtime pin PR 287 and CI logs
- Add 'model-variant-fallback' to rollout templates in Console (ticket JIRA-OPS-204)
- Check-in w/ finance for forecast impact of new Dedicated pricing tier

End-of-day check (tickboxes):
- [ ] Legal redlines sent
- [ ] Marco confirms engineer
- [ ] Canary metrics baseline captured
- [ ] Customer creds requested

Scratch: jot any quick ideas here — not for sharing:
- Could experiment with autoscaling cold-start pre-warming for heavy-predictable windows (30m prewarm) to shave tail-latency — get perf small experiment scheduled next sprint.
- Consider a concise "deployment maturity" rubric for product teams to know when to use Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (1-pager).
